name: Euphrates
note: The fourth river of Eden (Gen. 2:14) and the north-eastern edge of the promised land.

name: Tigris
note: The third river of Eden, "which flows east of Assyria" (Gen. 2:14).

name: Nile
note: Egypt's river. One reading makes it the Gihon of Eden (Gen. 2:13); the atlas marks that as uncertain.

name: Jordan
note: Crossed into Canaan (Josh. 3) and the river of Jesus' baptism (Matt. 3:13).
